audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Mordekaiser Level 1, First item and 2+ items. The packet chart reads Skill / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Skill / Mordekaiser / Gangplank / Gangplank, and the page's own whys[5] and whys[6] already say Gangplank reclaims the matchup at items.
audit.why: Level 1 Mordekaiser has one ability and no aura against a ranged Parrrley and keg placement — that is not an 8/10 row. And the late-game rows contradicted the late-game prose sitting beside them.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 5 and 6 flipped as one atomic group in both layers with ratings inverted from the mirror's audit (Skill 5/10, Gangplank 7/10 -> 3/10 ours, Gangplank 8/10 -> 2/10 ours), and phases[5].why / phases[6].why rewritten so the reason matches the side.

audit.why: Spike timings are right: Q+W at 2-3 before he owns crit, Realm of Death at 6 stranding placed kegs and his team outside, first item, then Gangplank's two-item crit spike. Left as-is.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns told the player to 'track Powder Kegs before every engage' as if it had a cooldown to wait out. Powder Keg's cooldown is 0 — it runs on stored charges. And nothing on the page said Cannon Barrage deals true damage.
audit.why: You cannot time a window around a charge-based ability, so the advice was unusable; the real counterplay is denying the keg or pulling him off the chain. Cannon Barrage is flagged trueDamage and global (160/140/120), which invalidates the usual 'stack resistances' answer.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rewritten around charges plus Remove Scurvy's 22s rank-1 cooldown; dontsFull[1].d replaced with the true-damage point; Cannon Barrage's 120s late cooldown written into phases[6].why.
sources: enemyKit Gangplank E cd 0, W 22/20/18/16/14, R trueDamage+global

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[5] was written about '2+ items' but sits on the First item row, so two adjacent rows explained the same timing.
audit.why: The first-item row is a distinct moment — his crit component lands before your second item — and it was being skipped.
audit.corrected: whys[5] rewritten to the first-item window without repeating the 2+ item text below it.

edits.before: Liandry's makes Darkness Rise melt through bruiser HP stacking. Extended trades are now strictly yours — force them.
edits.after: Liandry's still burns, but his first crit item and barrel-chain start out-damaging you — take trades only on a whiffed keg.

edits.before: Riftmaker omnivamp turns the Realm 1v1 unloseable into most matchups. Gangplank's only outs are dodging Q forever or never being alone — neither survives a whole game.
edits.after: Riftmaker keeps the Realm 1v1 strong, but stacked-barrel crits and a 120-second global Cannon Barrage out-value you everywhere else — win on objectives, not the sidelane.

edits.before: By 2+ items his barrel-wave crits out-damage my flatter late game and his W cleanses my E's slow and grievous wounds, so I can't reliably lock the full combo.
edits.after: His first crit item lands before my second: barrel chains chunk me from outside aura range and Remove Scurvy is up every 22s to undo the setup I paid for.

edits.before: - Gangplank Powder Kegs: matchup-defining — Pop barrels to deny poke + gold. Track it before every engage. - Gangplank Powder Keg: Places barrels that chain-explode when shot — his combo + poke. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Powder Keg: no cooldown, it runs on stored charges — you cannot wait it out, only deny it. Shoot a placed keg yourself or E-pull him off the chain before he detonates. - Remove Scurvy: 22s at rank 1, his cleanse and his heal.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Cannon Barrage's true damage ignores every resistance you buy — end it early.

notes: Both flagged suspectNames are false positives: 'Powder Kegs' is the correct name pluralised, 'Darkness Rise's' is the correct name with a possessive. No name changes made. UNVERIFIED and left alone: the page asserts in whys[6], spikes[3].text, mid, late and wants.foe[1] that Remove Scurvy cleanses the slow and Grievous Wounds off Mordekaiser's Death's Grasp. Riot's text for Death's Grasp says only 'pulls all enemies in an area' — no slow, no root, no Grievous Wounds — so both the effect and the cleanse are unsupported. The mirror agent hit the same wall and rewrote around it. I removed the claim from whys[5] where I was editing anyway and left the other four alone rather than guess. Also: the Mordekaiser kit file carries a derived 'grounding' flag on Q that Riot's Obliterate description does not support; I wrote nothing depending on it.
